entries.t: <FACE:0F>Navi, show me the data<NL>on the asteroid base<WAIT><FACE:53>Understood
<FACE:0F>This must be the<NL>control room… Take it<WAIT>or we can't break away
<FACE:0A>One straight path to<NL>get there, huh…
<FACE:14>Guess we've gotta take<NL>on the Sperobos, then
<FACE:19>But they want this<NL>Cluster too, right?<WAIT>If we just sit tight<NL>they won't break it
<FACE:05>Give them time and<NL>they'll bolt us down<WAIT>We can't leave, just<NL>what they want!<WAIT>We've gotta strike<NL>first!
<FACE:00>Yeah, I think so too<NL><WAIT>Seal it up so the<NL>Sperobos can't get in<WAIT>Then we storm in with<NL>everyone and end it!
<FACE:0F>Settled, then<NL>The raid begins!<NL>
<FACE:0F>Navi, is there a link<NL>tube in this Block?
<FACE:53>There is…<NL><WAIT>Conditions are unknown<NL>Safety's not assured
<FACE:00>That asteroid is the<NL>Sperobo Gang's hide…
<FACE:03>Gwuh!
<FACE:06>(Are you nuts?!)<NL><WAIT>(Tell the safety-first<NL>computer it's a base)<WAIT>(We'd never get out!)
<FACE:14>Huh? Did Hiyori do<NL>something to <PLAYER><WAIT>just now?<WAIT><FACE:1D>Couldn't see well, but<NL>looked like a punch…?
<FACE:0D>Really? Anemia, maybe?<NL>He crouches a lot…
<FACE:12>Th-that asteroid is…<NL>o-our secret mine<WAIT>A secret only I, the<NL>president, know of…
<FACE:53>I see. Understood<NL>Preparing to link up
<FACE:06>Geez! Being too honest<NL>is a problem too…
<FACE:04>But…<NL>
<FACE:04>(I think Navi is a<NL> dear friend too…)
<FACE:8E>Oh, <PLAYER>…<NL><WAIT>I read your Navi log<NL>Off to the «HQ», eh!
<FACE:03>Ah, Doctor!<WAIT><FACE:04>Not in front of Navi…

<FACE:8E>I know<NL>I have plenty to say…<WAIT>but there's no other<NL>way… Now then<WAIT>I'll update your<NL>Medawatch's program<WAIT>so you can talk to the<NL>Cluster the whole way<WAIT><FACE:00>Thank you, Doctor!
<FACE:22>…Who?<NL><WAIT>…Navi?<NL><WAIT>I… don't change…?
<FACE:53><SFX:6A>Niwaka…<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:0010><CLEAR>Why is it that you<NL>never change?<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:000A><END>

<FACE:53>I…<NL><WAIT>I believed that humans<NL>unlike us machines<WAIT>change day by day and<NL>move forward…<WAIT>But you have not<NL>changed at all<WAIT>Rather than a human…<NL><WAIT>you seem closer to us<NL>machines…
<FACE:22>Navi… you…!
<FACE:04>(Niwaka…<NL> he's pretty down…)

<FACE:00>Niwaka…<NL>Sure, that was a bust<WAIT>but don't be so down<NL>We'll handle it<WAIT>We won't lose to those<NL>Sperobo weirdos<WAIT>You guard the Cluster<WAIT><FACE:22>…<WAIT><FACE:04>…Okay?<WAIT><FACE:22>…<WAIT><FACE:00>Right, I'm counting<NL>on you
